verdict.rationale: Weave documents a public REST Service API at https://trace.wandb.ai with API-key bearer auth. That host serves a complete OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec covering 117 paths, plus a live Swagger UI, a ReDoc view and per-endpoint 'Try it' playgrounds, so the product can be driven programmatically through a documented public API. The spec path listed in the docs llms.txt returns 404, but the working spec at trace.wandb.ai/openapi.json answers, so this is a docs glitch rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: an API-specific versioning/deprecation policy (no version headers in the spec), independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API, and a consistent docs-hosted spec link.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Use the Weave Service API, which provides REST endpoints for programmatic access to Weave functionality.

The Weave trace API host serves a complete machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document at the well-known path, covering the full service surface (117 paths, including /call/start and /calls/stream_query).
The trace API hosts a live Swagger UI that loads /openapi.json, a runnable in-page console against the production API
